program.help:
Second-pass spike detection with mask exclusion and IN-PLACE shadow clustering. Detects additional low-amplitude spikes missed by the main detection pass, then classifies each new spike into the "shadow" of its nearest existing cluster (by robust Mahalanobis distance) or into a single unmatched bin. The new spikes are merged directly into $session.{res,spk,fet,clu}.N — no parallel stem.
PIPELINE
1. process_reextractspikes scans $session.fil using per-group thresholds derived by scaling process_medianthreshold's baseline by reextractThresholdFactor. Any candidate peak within ± reextractMaskHalfWidth samples of a timestamp already listed in $session.res.N is rejected. New spikes land at $session-reextr-tmp.{res,spk}.N.
2. Originals are copied to $session.<ext>.<N>.bak for crash recovery the first time the script runs. Subsequent runs preserve the earlier .bak files.
3. process_shadowcluster merges the new spikes into the primary session files. Writes go to .tmp files first and are renamed atomically, so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the originals. The inflation guard (v1.1+) caps per-parent absorption so one over-dispersed cluster cannot swallow the entire new-spike population; excess spikes are demoted to the unmatched bin.
4. (optional, reextractAutoSubcluster=1) ndm_subcluster_unmatched is invoked on the merged session so the unmatched bin — now larger due to the inflation guard — receives clustering rather than sitting as one amorphous pile.
CLUSTER ID CONVENTION
shadow(k) = maxExistingId + 1 + k (paired with existing cluster k) unmatched = maxExistingId + 1 + maxExistingId + 1
PREREQUISITES
The primary detection + PCA + clustering pipeline must have completed first. Required input files per group N: $session.res.N $session.spk.N $session.fet.N $session.clu.N $session.pca.N
The following parameters are inherited from ndm_extractspikes: thresholdFactor refractoryPeriod peakSearchLength start / duration (for baseline estimation)
PARAMETERS
# reextractThresholdFactor (default: 0.75)
Scale factor applied to the per-group median-threshold baseline to obtain the re-extraction threshold. Lower values recover more low-amplitude events but also admit more noise crossings. Typical range: 0.5 .. 0.9.
# reextractMaskHalfWidth (default: refractoryPeriod)
Minimum sample distance a new candidate peak must maintain from every original spike timestamp. Defaults to the main refractory period.
# reextractMinClusterSize (default: 50)
Existing clusters with fewer members are not eligible as parents for shadow assignment (median / MAD statistics unreliable below this).
# reextractChi2 (default: 0.999)
χ² quantile for the squared-Mahalanobis admission threshold. Lower is stricter; higher is permissive. Previously 0.9999 — lowered to 0.999 in 2026-04 because 0.9999 × MAD-based σ's proved over-permissive on heavy-tailed reference clusters and produced runaway absorption.
# reextractExtraFeat (default: auto)
Whether the reference .fet.N includes the per-channel peak features appended by process_pca -x: auto (inferred from dimensionality), 0, or 1. Normal users leave this on auto.
# reextractInflationRatio (default: 5.0)
Upper bound on per-parent absorption expressed as a multiple of the parent's reference size. A parent with |parent|=1868 spikes may absorb at most max(reextractInflationCap, 5.0 × 1868) = 9340 new spikes. Excess spikes (those with the largest Mahalanobis d²) are demoted to the unmatched bin. Set to 0 to disable the guard.
# reextractInflationCap (default: 500)
Absolute minimum cap on per-parent absorption — small reference clusters (size ~ 50-100) still get to absorb at least this many new spikes regardless of reextractInflationRatio. Set to 0 to disable the guard (same effect as reextractInflationRatio=0).
# reextractAutoSubcluster (default: 0)
When 1, ndm_subcluster_unmatched is invoked automatically on the merged session after re-extraction, clustering the unmatched bin immediately. When 0 (default), the operator must run ndm_subcluster_unmatched manually after inspecting the intermediate result.
OUTPUT
Merges in-place into $session.{res,spk,fet,clu}.N. Originals are preserved at $session.<ext>.<N>.bak on first run — rename them back over the primary files to revert.
NEXT STEPS
Open $session in klusters to review the shadow clusters and either merge them into their parents, tune them as separate units, or reject them.
SEE ALSO
ndm_reextractspikes_stderiv — spatial+temporal derivative variant. ndm_subcluster_unmatched — re-cluster the unmatched bin.
